title: Vesalius's Fabrica remaps the human body
summary: Andreas Vesalius published a richly illustrated anatomy textbook based on his own dissections of human bodies.
why: Corrected hundreds of Galen's errors by trusting direct study of human bodies over ancient authority.

notes.problem: 'Founded modern anatomy' is not in the source; it says the Fabrica rectified about 300 of Galen's errors.
